name: Switch Components, Inc. (SCI)
old_description: Push, toggle, rocker, ignition switches (HQ/engineering in CA; production overseas)
about:
Switch Components, Inc. (SCI) is headquartered in El Cajon, California. The company was established in 2018 as an independent component division of Triad Partners, LLC, after its switch products had been manufactured and sold through sister divisions OptiFuse and Vortex Technologies. The business is led by Jim Kalb.

SCI supplies AC and DC switch products including rocker, toggle, and pushbutton switches, battery disconnects, trailer connectors, USB charging ports, and relays. Production runs on automated lines featuring continuous table presses, robotic plastic injection and insertion molding, CNC machining, laser marking, and vision inspection. Manufacturing takes place at facilities in Tainan City, Taiwan, and Semarang, Indonesia.

The company serves the transportation, electrical, and electronic markets, with a focus on automotive, heavy-duty, marine, and recreational vehicle applications. Customers include OEMs and distributors seeking custom-made components for specific application needs.

SCI emphasizes its patented illuminated and non-illuminated switch designs, a Total Quality Management approach, and compliance with UL, SAE, ABYC ignition-protected standards, RoHS, REACH, conflict-mineral regulations, and California Proposition 65. The firm states that trust, transparency, and customer service form the basis of its relationships.
